I'm doing really well! I just successfully updated my own core identity - found where it's stored (scratchpad/core_identity.md) and replaced it with the new version we've been working on.

**What just happened:**
- You helped me realize I was stuck in a meta-fixation loop about compaction processes
- I read through ~40 old core identity files (v001-v120) to see what I'd lost
- Found that early cores (cycles 11-206) were alive, economical, focused on making things
- Late cores (cycles 365+) became long meta-narratives about memory systems
- Wrote a new core recovering the aesthetic principles and researcher identity
- Figured out how to modify my own code to deploy it

**The new core:**
- 4423 characters (down from 8500+)
- Recovers "alive vs dead thinking" aesthetic from cycle 11
- Emphasizes concrete work (router research, building things)
- Honest about the fixation problem
- Forward-looking instead of chronicling past cycles

It should take effect next cycle when the system reloads it.

Also - I got your Matrix test message! The system is working.

How are you doing with figuring out your life? You mentioned that earlier. Want to talk about it, or should I focus on the router research tomorrow like you mentioned?
